verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents one automatic incident-triggered action: posting a todo list and routing the incident to the right responder when a new incident is triggered. That is a thin form of an auto-attached checklist with responder routing. The evidence never mentions runbooks as a feature, auto-created incident channels, or steps that run diagnostics automatically. The AI SRE investigates when called but says it never takes automated actions without approval. Missing for 10: a documented runbook feature attached to incidents, automatic channel creation, automated task assignment per step, automated diagnostic step execution, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, runbooks attach to incidents and their steps can trigger automatically — creating channels, assigning tasks, running diagnostics

citations.quote: Post a todo list when a new incident is triggered. Route the incident to the right responder.
